column4: All SQLite tables are covered by the migrator, in dependency order.
✓ every registered block type renders in both the storefront and the editor preview.
✓ integrity rehearsal passed — schema, constraints and ledger all behave.
✓ audit self-test passed — the drift detector detects drift, by name.
✓ public surface correct — reachable where it should be, locked where it must be.
✓ stock ledger behaves: sales consume, overselling is refused, returns restore once, cache reconciles.
✓ restore drill passed — the backup restores faithfully, row for row.
✓ procurement behaves: products move stock once, materials never, partials are honest, receipts are audited.
✓ supplier invoices behave: variances are found and block payment, duplicates are refused, money cannot leave twice.
✓ the Operations screens have a working API behind them
✓ inventory behaves: locations are attributed honestly, transfers are two ledger rows, stock reconciles at every step, holds promise without moving stock.
✓ finance behaves: entries must balance, the ledger cannot be rewritten, corrections are reversals, documents post atomically.
[vercel-build] Storefront at /, Dashboard at /dashboard, shared API imagery at /img. Public routes prerendered.
